title: AI Catalogue
baseline: The native catalogue and interfaces predate this split. Shared-preview PR #81 and curator-profile PR #83 remain open. Legacy issues #1-#14 have been reconciled to pinned source evidence and explicit remaining acceptance work below; none is closed by source inspection or this planning merge.
owns: Canonical AI manifests, taxonomy, runtime/hardware policy, evidence and code/weights licensing.
AI-specific discovery, curator policy, promotion adapter and editorial content.
excludes: Duplicated engine UI, generic scheduling/MCP/publishing infrastructure.
Breaking stable package/CLI/MCP identities or treating generic search as hardware proof.

phases.title: Non-breaking adoption and naming
exitCriteria: #79 and child #84 preserve stable IDs/interfaces and correct active naming; retain the primary explorer until parity is verified.

phases.title: Complete dataset and interface parity
exitCriteria: #85 runs the native and shared test matrix on the complete dataset; #80 closes only after distribution and rollback are verified.

phases.title: Review-only curation and approved promotion
exitCriteria: #82 configuration is integrated; #86 validates approved native patches through the shared contract; live activation separately satisfies engine #7.

phases.title: AI journal and release prerequisites
exitCriteria: #87 proves draft exclusion and page/feed correspondence; approved content, URLs and rights are checked before any edition.

phases.title: Audited native implementation and remaining work
exitCriteria: Source-inspected residual scope is recorded for #1-#14. Close each implementation ticket only after its remaining checks or measured reports are attached; this planning pass does not execute models or certify devices.

items.title: Branding, repository/Pages URLs and compatibility aliases
Legacy interface retirement gate
items.notes: Parent of #85; preserve translations, ranking, package and MCP contracts until acceptance.

items.title: Full-source search, export and served-interface parity
Approved AI proposals to canonical YAML
items.notes: Shared coordination: engine #8. Never synthesize benchmark evidence or weights rights.

items.title: Revision-linked AI comparisons and shared journal
Reproducible benchmark harness
items.notes: Reuse the isolated runner and three adapters. Remaining: verify every requested metric and null/unsupported state, attach real Apple Silicon/Raspberry Pi acceptance reports, and complete sustained RV1106 work in #2. Tooling and Linux smoke observations are not device acceptance.

items.title: RV1106 / SEEN-0 benchmark stack
items.notes: The coexistence monitor is not an RV1106 benchmark. Remaining: capture/encode, API, display and one supported RKNN detector on the actual 256 MB board; record drops, queue age, thermals and memory. Whistle/Needle stay unverified until demonstrated.

items.title: Hardware compatibility matrix
items.notes: Exact-environment RAM filtering exists. Remaining: generate and test per-hardware runtime/format/accelerator indexes with explicit reported/reproduced/unknown states and negative-fit cases; do not infer hardware compatibility from a generic shared preview.

items.title: Native searchable catalogue site
items.notes: The native static explorer, comparison and entry pages exist; do not rebuild them. Remaining: audit the original requested filter matrix and benchmark history against complete data, attach served-browser/accessibility evidence, and coordinate shared-interface cutover with #85.

items.title: Versioned machine-readable JSON indexes
items.notes: Canonical YAML already generates JSON exports and package/CLI/MCP surfaces. Remaining: document and test schema-version compatibility, all requested task/domain/hardware/runtime/compatibility indexes, stable IDs and actual static-host consumption. Shared export parity belongs to #85.

items.title: Benchmark evidence schema
items.notes: Benchmark schema v1 exists. Remaining: tighten nested validation and document firmware, conversion, throughput, utilization, power method and thermal fields with null/unsupported semantics, valid/invalid fixtures and backwards-compatible migration. Do not invent missing measurements.

items.title: Audio coverage
items.notes: Snapshot has 53 audio records, not 53 edge-tested models. Remaining: map the eight requested audio task families to model-level entries, audit primary sources/code and weights rights, identify gaps and process a bounded reviewed batch with unknown runtime/RAM fields preserved.

items.title: Vision coverage
items.notes: Snapshot has 115 vision records, not verified coverage of every requested task. Remaining: map detection through low-light enhancement, audit model versus toolkit roles, retain conversion/NPU evidence separately and review a bounded gap-filling batch.

items.title: Sensor and industrial coverage
items.notes: Snapshot has seven sensor and three manufacturing records. Remaining: audit vibration, IMU, radar, fall detection, maintenance, anomaly, environment and fusion coverage; distinguish vendor collections from individual usable models and retain explicit deployment unknowns.

items.title: Geospatial and scientific coverage
items.notes: Snapshot has geospatial, science, time-series and weather entries. Remaining: build the requested task/source coverage matrix, record input-data/downstream-head requirements and audit local-inference evidence; metadata counts alone do not close this research workstream.

items.title: Evidence/completeness scoring
items.notes: Coverage/unknown counters exist; they are not acceptance of the requested per-entry score. Remaining: define a transparent completeness rubric, expose missing fields and test edge cases across model/toolkit/primitive roles. Completeness must never be presented as model quality or measured performance.

items.title: Link, manifest and generated-drift checks
items.notes: Schema/test/drift/audit workflows and a non-blocking weekly link audit exist. Remaining: verify each original vocabulary/duplicate/evidence requirement against full data, capture successful CI/link reports after runner recovery and coordinate rename/parity with #84/#85. Workflow presence is not a passing execution.

items.title: Embodied AI and learned-control coverage
items.notes: Snapshot has 11 control and 14 robotics records. Remaining: map all requested embodied-control families and audit control rate, observations/actions, actuators, safety envelope and exact hardware evidence; retain absent values as unknown. Counts do not imply safe executable controllers.

items.title: Bounded tiny-model training examples
items.notes: Training guidance and inference recipes do not establish the four requested end-to-end training pipelines. Remaining: bounded IMU, vibration, image and simulated-servo examples with declared budgets, non-ML baselines, dataset provenance, train/export steps and actual device or simulator reports.
